title: March Madness Bracket Predictor
text: Built an ensemble prediction model combining XGBoost and stacked logistic regression to predict NCAA tournament game outcomes, achieving 78% accuracy across 10 years of historical matchups. Engineered 40+ differential features from KenPom, EvanMiya, and Barttorvik metrics (adjusted efficiency, ELO, SOS, shooting splits, Four Factors) and applied correlation filtering to reduce multicollinearity.

title: Krish Bothra
text:
About me
Hi, thanks so much for visiting my website! I’m a Computer Science & Data Science student at UW–Madison, passionate about AI systems, sports analytics, and building things that turn data into decisions.
I love working at the intersection of data, sports, and software — whether that’s predicting March Madness upsets, modeling NFL play outcomes, or building perception systems for autonomous vehicles. Outside of coursework, I enjoy digging into sports analytics projects and exploring new ways AI can automate real-world workflows.
This summer I am participating in the Carnegie Mellon Sports Analytics Camp (CMSACamp).
